findings.current: and Lee Jungryong had shut him out afterward.
findings.defect: The source says Lee Jungryong thoroughly excluded him; “shut him out” omits the emphasis of 철저히.
findings.rationale: The Korean explicitly says 이정룡에 의해 철저히 배제되었다, meaning he was thoroughly or completely excluded by Lee Jungryong.
findings.replacement: and Lee Jungryong had completely shut him out afterward.

summary: The chapter is faithful overall, with one minor omission of emphasis in the description of Team Leader Choi’s exclusion.
